page.overview:
What is Battle against the Benathy?

At some point following the Great Jedi Purge, Darth Vader went to a world in Wild Space where he fought the Benathy after his demands were not fulfilled. Thousands on both sides died, according to Kristoff. Though the Empire fought well, they were unable to defeat the Benathy's god, a massive Zillo Beast.
